tts.emptyTitle: Voice settings live with the character
tts.emptyBody: TTS is controlled by the active character preset on the backend. There is nothing to configure here yet.

general.voiceOutputHelp: When OFF, Mili answers as text only and no speech audio is generated. This is different from the quick speaker mute.
general.lifeStateHelp: When ON, a small floating panel shows Mili's live simulated-life state (read-only). OFF hides the panel only and never stops the world simulation.
general.customBgUrl: Or enter a custom background URL
general.imageCompressionQualityHelp: JPEG compression quality (0.1-1.0). Default is 0.8 to reduce file size when transmitting images to AI models, as we don't compress images during API transmission which could result in large file sizes.
general.imageMaxWidthHelp: Maximum width for image resizing. Images exceeding this width will be proportionally scaled down. Set to 0 for no size limit. This feature exists because some AI models may have limitations when processing very large images. However, most AI models can handle images automatically, so the default is 0 (no restriction) to preserve your original images.

asr.autoStopMic: Auto Stop Mic When AI Start Speaking
asr.autoStopMicDesc: Automatically stops microphone when AI begins speaking to prevent audio feedback
asr.autoStartMicOnConvEnd: Auto Start Mic When Conversation End
asr.autoStartMicOnConvEndDesc: Automatically restarts microphone when AI finishes speaking for seamless conversation
asr.autoStartMicOn: Auto Start Mic When AI Interrupted
asr.autoStartMicOnDesc: Automatically restarts microphone when you interrupt AI for continuous interaction
asr.positiveSpeechThresholdDesc: Minimum confidence level (1-100) required to detect speech. Higher values reduce false positives
asr.negativeSpeechThresholdDesc: Confidence level (0-100) below which speech detection stops. Lower values make detection less sensitive
asr.redemptionFramesDesc: Number of consecutive frames (1-100) needed to confirm speech detection. Higher values reduce noise triggers

agent.idleSecondsToSpeak: Idle seconds allow AI to speak
agent.allowButtonTrigger: Prompt AI to Speak via Raise Hand Button
agent.resetRelationshipHelp: Reset Mili's relationship for ALL chats. Chat history, summaries, and long-term memory stay intact.
agent.resetRelationshipConfirm: Reset Mili's relationship across all conversations? Chat history will not be deleted.
agent.characterMemoryHelp: Facts Mili remembers across all chats (long-term context, not a transcript).
agent.memoryDescription: Facts Mili remembers about you across all conversations.
agent.deleteMemoryConfirm: Remove this fact from Mili's long-term memory?
agent.resetMemoryConfirm: Clear all of Mili's long-term memory? Relationship and chat history stay intact.
agent.resetCharacterStateHelp: Reset Mili's relationship to stranger and clear all long-term memory across every chat.
agent.resetCharacterStateConfirm: Reset Mili's relationship and clear long-term memory across all chats? Chat history will not be deleted.
agent.attachmentMemoryDescription: What Mili remembers from files shared in any chat. Original files are not kept.
agent.deleteAttachmentConfirm: Forget this attachment and its known copies?
agent.clearAttachmentsConfirm: Clear all attachment memories? Chat history stays intact.
agent.purgeComplete: Fully forgotten — no known copies remain.
agent.purgeUnknown: Deletion status unknown — nothing was confirmed.
agent.purgeLegacy: Forgotten. Older backend did not report remaining copies.
